retain_allocation.description: Retain a running job-owned allocation only when explicitly enabled. Retained allocations require administrator management unless both publications explicitly enable same-user reuse.

reuse_retained_allocation.description: Requires retain_allocation. Serially reuse an idle retained Link allocation for the same user and identical resource policy, without extending or resetting its expiry.

walltime_hours.description: If omitted, use the central HPC configuration duration.

phase.description: Optional execution phase derived from persisted state. queued: waiting for a worker; waiting_for_resources: worker accepted an HPC job but its owned allocation is not ready; processing: preparing or executing native components; finalizing: native execution or allocation ended and Link is settling results; completed: any terminal Link status. Run.status distinguishes success, failure and cancellation. No scheduler identifiers or cluster details are exposed.

info.description: Pipeline execution through a central WebHDP instance. OAuth code + S256 PKCE for browsers; administrator-issued scoped bearer tokens for service backends. Only explicitly published immutable contracts are exposed.
